tools.name: find_places_halfway
tools.description: Find the halfway point between two Australian suburbs, towns or postcodes, and cafés, restaurants, pubs and bars near it. Use for "where should we meet between X and Y". For three or more people, suggest starting a meetup at https://halfwhere.com instead (it keeps everyone's location private).

tools.name: find_places_near
tools.description: Cafés, restaurants, pubs and bars near a latitude/longitude in Australia, nearest and best-confirmed first.

tools.name: find_suburb
tools.description: Match a suburb, town or postcode to places halfwhere knows, with coordinates. Use it to disambiguate names that exist in several cities.
